INVOICE INV-1042
Vendor: Acme Supplies
Bill to: Northwind Labs
Issue date: 2026-01-10
Due date: 2026-02-09
Total amount: 12500 USD. Payment terms: net 30 days. Late payments incur a 2 percent monthly fee.

INVOICE INV-1043
Vendor: Globex Services
Bill to: Northwind Labs
Issue date: 2026-01-12
Due date: 2026-01-27
Total amount: 3200 EUR. This invoice covers network maintenance. Payment terms: net 15 days.

SERVICE CONTRACT
Parties: Northwind Labs and Acme Supplies. Effective date: 2026-01-01. Expiration date: 2026-12-31. Renewal terms: automatic annual renewal unless either party gives 60 days written notice before expiration. Governing law: California. Acme must provide support within 4 hours for critical incidents.

MAINTENANCE CONTRACT
Parties: Globex Services and Northwind Labs. Effective date: 2026-02-01. Expiration date: 2027-01-31. Renewal requires a new signed agreement; there is no automatic renewal. Governing law: New York. Critical support response time is 24 hours.

Jordan Lee
Email: jordan@example.test
Skills: Python, AWS, PostgreSQL. Jordan has 7 years of software engineering experience. Most recently Jordan built distributed data pipelines at Cedar Systems. Education: BS Computer Science, Harbor University, 2019.

Sam Patel
Email: sam@example.test
Skills: Java, Azure, Kubernetes. Sam has 4 years of software engineering experience. Sam maintained financial reporting services at Elm Finance. Education: BS Software Engineering, Valley College, 2022.

Cedar Systems Annual Financial Report
Period: fiscal year 2025. Revenue: 8000000 USD. Net income: 1200000 USD. Revenue increased 25 percent compared with fiscal year 2024. Recurring cloud subscriptions contributed 60 percent of revenue.

INSURANCE CLAIM CLM-77
Claimant: Northwind Labs. Policy number: POL-900. Incident date: 2026-01-15. A burst pipe damaged servers in the laboratory. Claim amount: 45000 USD. Status: under review. The insurer has not yet approved payment.

queries.question: When is Acme invoice INV-1042 due?
How much does Northwind owe Acme Supplies on INV-1042?
What currency is INV-1043 denominated in?
How much notice is required to prevent the Acme contract from renewing?
Does the Globex maintenance contract renew automatically, and what is required to renew it?
queries.reference_answer: No. A new signed agreement is required.

queries.question: Compare the critical support response times promised by Acme and Globex.
Give the full name of the candidate who knows Python and AWS, and their years of experience.
queries.reference_answer: Jordan Lee has 7 years of experience.

queries.question: What was Cedar Systems net income in fiscal year 2025?
Has claim CLM-77 been approved for payment, and what is its current status?
queries.reference_answer: No. The claim is under review.
